paragraphs: Baxter International Inc., through our subsidiaries, provides a broad portfolio of essential healthcare products, including sterile intravenous (IV) solutions; infusion systems and devices; parenteral nutrition therapies; inhaled anesthetics; generic injectable pharmaceuticals; surgical hemostat and sealant products; advanced surgical equipment; smart bed systems; patient monitoring and diagnostic technologies; and respiratory health devices. These products are used by hospitals, nursing homes, rehabilitation centers, ambulatory surgery centers, doctors' offices, kidney dialysis centers and patients at home under physician supervision. Our global footprint and the critical nature of our products and services play a key role in expanding access to healthcare in emerging and developed countries. As of December 31, 2025, after giving effect to the sale of our Kidney Care business (as discussed below), we manufactured products in over 20 countries and sold them in over 100 countries.

Baxter International Inc. was incorporated under Delaware law in 1931. As used in this report, "we", "our" or "us" means Baxter International Inc. and its consolidated subsidiaries, unless the context otherwise requires.
Since January 2023, we have completed several strategic actions, as discussed below. Sale of Kidney Care Business

On August 12, 2024, we entered into an Equity Purchase Agreement (EPA) with certain affiliates of Carlyle Group Inc. (Carlyle) to sell our Kidney Care business. That business, which is now known as Vantive Health LLC (Vantive) is comprised of our former Kidney Care segment. On January 31, 2025, we completed the sale of our Kidney Care business to Carlyle for an aggregate purchase price of $3.80 billion in cash, subject to certain closing cash, working capital and debt adjustments. After giving effect to certain adjustments, we received approximately $3.71 billion pre-tax cash proceeds at closing of the transaction with the net after tax proceeds of approximately $3.3 billion, prior to giving effects to certain post-closing adjustments. As of December 31, 2025, we repaid $3.81 billion of legacy indebtedness in 2025 (which repayment does not include $2.00 billion of indebtedness repaid with proceeds from a new notes offering) primarily with the net after-tax proceeds from the sale of our Kidney Care business. The financial position, results of operations and cash flows of our Kidney Care business, including our gain from the sale of that business and the related cash proceeds received, are reported as discontinued operations in the accompanying consolidated financial statements, and our prior period results have been adjusted to reflect discontinued operations.

In the third quarter of 2023, we completed the implementation of a new operating model intended to simplify and streamline our operations and better align our manufacturing and supply chain to our commercial activities. Under this operating model, our business is currently comprised of three reportable segments: Medical Products & Therapies, Healthcare Systems & Technologies, and Pharmaceuticals.

On September 29, 2023, we completed the sale of our BioPharma Solutions (BPS) business and received cash proceeds of $3.96 billion from that transaction. The results of operations and cash flows of our BPS business, including the $2.88 billion pre-tax gain ($2.59 billion net of tax) from the sale of that business and the related cash proceeds received, are reported as discontinued operations in the accompanying consolidated financial statements. We used substantially all of the after-tax proceeds from this transaction to repay certain of our debt obligations, including $514 million of commercial paper borrowings and $2.28 billion of long-term debt that we repaid during the fourth quarter of 2023, as well as €750 million of senior notes that we repaid during the second quarter of 2024.
We currently manage our global operations based on three reportable segments: Medical Products & Therapies, Healthcare Systems & Technologies and Pharmaceuticals.

The Medical Products & Therapies segment includes sales of our sterile IV solutions, infusion systems, administration sets, parenteral nutrition therapies and surgical hemostat, sealant and adhesion prevention products. The Healthcare Systems & Technologies segment includes sales of our connected care solutions and collaboration tools, including smart bed systems, patient monitoring systems and diagnostic technologies, respiratory health devices and advanced equipment for the surgical space, including operating room integration technologies, precision positioning devices and other accessories. The Pharmaceuticals segment includes sales of specialty injectable pharmaceuticals, inhaled anesthetics and drug compounding services.
For financial information about our segments, see Note 17 in Item 8 of this Annual Report on Form 10-K.

Our business strategy is focused on driving sustainable growth and innovation aligned with our mission to save and sustain lives and our vision to redefine healthcare delivery. Our diversified and broad portfolio of medical products that treat acute or chronic conditions and our global presence are core components of our strategy as we work to achieve these objectives. We are focused on improving performance and driving a culture of continuous improvement across the enterprise.

Our innovation strategy, which encompasses both organic and inorganic initiatives over the longer term, is focused on accelerating our sales growth through the introduction of new customer centric connected care and core therapy offerings. Connected care offerings include devices or software that can digitally connect, communicate and/or analyze data to help transform healthcare and improve patient outcomes, and we are continuing to build out our connected care portfolio offerings, which includes smart bed systems, infusion pumps, patient monitoring and diagnostic technologies, respiratory health devices and advanced equipment for the surgical space. Our core therapy product offerings include pharmaceuticals and consumable medical products designed to address essential patient and provider needs across the continuum of care.

As part of this strategy, we are prioritizing investments that drive innovation in product areas where we believe we have compelling opportunities to better serve patients and healthcare professionals, particularly in markets with higher growth rates. We are working to accelerate the pace at which we bring these advances to market to support our future growth.

Our strategy also involves active portfolio management in the interest of maximizing value for Baxter stockholders and best positioning Baxter for long-term success, consistent with our profitability objectives. We regularly assess the strategic fit of businesses in our portfolio and the geographies in which we have operations. Portfolio changes may also result from channel expansion or market development activities.

As discussed above under "Recent Strategic Actions," in the third quarter of 2023, we implemented a new operating model intended to simplify and streamline our operations and better align our manufacturing and supply chain to our commercial activities. These changes put us on a path to become a more integrated and nimble organization that should be able to respond more effectively to operational challenges and changes in the macroeconomic environment while enhancing our ability to drive innovation in, and continued optimization of our product portfolio. In July 2025, Andrew Hider was appointed as our President and Chief Executive Officer and we continue work to streamline the organization through the elimination of managerial layers that are intended to simplify our organization, accelerate innovation, bring us closer to our customers and improve performance.

Risks Related to Our Common Stock
We are exposed to risks as a result of our strategic actions.
We may not achieve the anticipated benefits of our significant transactions, including the sale of our Kidney Care business and our acquisition of Hillrom.
Our significant indebtedness requires us to use a substantial amount of our cash flow for debt service and constrains our ability to pursue growth strategies and advance our R&D capabilities.
We may be unable to successfully introduce or monetize new and existing products or services or keep pace with changing consumer preferences and needs or advances in technology.
We may not achieve our financial goals.
We have experienced disruptions in our supply chain.
Global economic conditions, including inflation, have adversely affected, and could continue to adversely affect, our operations.
Our operating results and financial condition have fluctuated and may in the future continue to fluctuate.
Changes in foreign currency exchange rates and interest rates have had, and may in the future have, an adverse effect on our results of operations, financial condition, cash flows, and liquidity.
Future material impairments in the value of our goodwill, intangible assets, and other long-lived assets would negatively affect our operating results.
Segments of our business are significantly dependent on major contracts with GPOs, IDNs, and certain other distributors and purchasers.
We may be unable to obtain sufficient components or raw materials on a timely basis or for a cost-effective price.
We may experience manufacturing, sterilization, supply, or distribution difficulties.
We have experienced and may continue to experience issues with quality management or product quality.
We may experience breaches and breakdowns affecting our information technology systems or protected information, including from obsolescence, cyber security breaches and data leakage.
We are exposed to risks associated with incorporating AI, machine learning and other emerging technologies into our products, services and operations.
We are subject to risks associated with doing business globally.
paragraphs: In addition to the other information in this Annual Report on Form 10-K, stockholders or prospective investors should carefully consider the following risk factors for a description of the principal risks that we face. If any of the events described below occurs, our business, results of operations, financial condition, cash flows, future growth prospects, reputation or stock price could suffer. Further, other unknown or unpredictable factors could also have significant adverse effects on our future results.

This summary of risks below is intended to provide an overview of the risks we face and should not be considered a substitute for the more detailed risk factors discussed immediately following this summary.
•We are exposed to risks as a result of our strategic actions.
•We may not achieve the anticipated benefits of our significant transactions, including the sale of our Kidney Care business and our acquisition of Hillrom.
•Our significant indebtedness requires us to use a substantial amount of our cash flow for debt service and constrains our ability to pursue growth strategies and advance our R&D capabilities.

•There is substantial competition in the product markets in which we operate and the risk of declining demand and pricing pressures could adversely affect our business, results of operations, financial condition and cash flows.

Baxter International Inc.，透過我們的子公司，提供廣泛的必要醫療產品組合，包括無菌靜脈（IV）溶液；輸液系統與設備；靜脈營養療法；吸入性麻醉劑；一般注射用製藥；手術止血與密封產品；先進手術設備；智慧牀系統；病人監測與診斷技術；以及呼吸健康設備。這些產品由醫院、護理之家、復健中心、門診手術中心、醫生診所、腎臟透析中心及在家接受醫師監督的病人使用。我們的全球據點與產品與服務的關鍵性，在擴大開發中國家與已開發國家醫療服務存取方面扮演關鍵角色。截至2025年12月31日，扣除我們出售腎臟照護業務（如下所述）後，我們在超過20個國家製造產品，並在超過100個國家銷售。
Baxter International Inc. 於1931年根據特拉華州法律設立。本報告中所使用的「我們」、「我們的」或「我們」，指 Baxter International Inc. 及其合併子公司，除非文意另有說明。
自2023年1月起，我們已完成數項戰略行動，如下所述。出售腎臟照護業務

於 2024 年 8 月 12 日，本公司與 Carlyle Group Inc.（Carlyle）之部分關係企業簽訂 Equity Purchase Agreement（EPA），以出售本公司之腎臟照護業務。該業務現已更名為 Vantive Health LLC（Vantive），為本公司先前之腎臟照護分部。於 2025 年 1 月 31 日，本公司完成出售腎臟照護業務予 Carlyle，總計現金購買價格為 3.80 十億美元，扣除特定交割現金、營運資金及負債調整後計算。經特定調整後，本公司於交易交割時收到約 3.71 十億美元預稅現金，淨稅後現金約為 3.3 十億美元，扣除特定交割後調整前。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，本公司於 2025 年償還 3.81 十億美元之遺留負債（此償還不包含以新債券發行所得資金償還之 2.00 十億美元負債），主要以出售腎臟照護業務所得之淨稅後現金償還。本公司腎臟照護業務之財務狀況、營運成果及現金流，包括出售該業務之獲利及相關現金所得，於隨附之合併財務報表中列為已終止營運，且本公司之前期財務資料已調整以反映已終止營運。
在2023年第三季，我們完成了新作業模式的實施，旨在簡化與優化我們的作業流程，並更好地將製造與供應鏈與我們的商業活動對齊。根據此作業模式，我們的業務目前由三個應報告分部組成：醫療產品與療法、醫療系統與科技，以及製藥。

於 2023 年 9 月 29 日，本公司完成出售 BioPharma Solutions（BPS）業務，並自該交易中收到 3.96 十億美元現金。本公司 BPS 業務之營運成果及現金流，包括出售該業務之預稅獲利 2.88 十億美元（淨稅後 2.59 十億美元）及相關現金所得，於隨附之合併財務報表中列為已終止營運。本公司以該交易所得之稅後現金 substantially all 用以償還部分債務義務，包括 2023 年第四季償還之 5.14 億美元商業紙債借款及 2.28 十億美元長期債務，以及 2024 年第二季償還之 7.5 億歐元高級債券。
我們目前根據三個應報告分部管理全球業務：醫療產品與療法、醫療系統與科技以及製藥。
醫療產品與療法分部包括我們無菌靜脈（IV）溶液、輸液系統、輸液管、靜脈營養療法以及手術止血、密封與黏連預防產品的銷售。醫療系統與科技分部包括我們的連接照護解決方案與協作工具銷售，包括智慧牀系統、病人監測系統與診斷技術、呼吸健康設備以及先進手術設備，包括手術室整合技術、精準定位設備及其他配件。製藥分部包括我們的專利注射製藥、吸入性麻醉劑與藥物製備服務的銷售。
有關我們各應報告分部之財務資訊，請參閱本年度報告表 10-K 第 8 項附註 17。
本公司業務策略著重於推動可持續成長與創新，與本公司使命「拯救並延續生命」及願景「重新定義醫療照護」相一致。我們多元且廣泛的醫療產品組合，用以治療急性或慢性病症，以及我們的全球佈局，是我們實現這些目標的關鍵零組件。我們致力於提升績效，並推動企業內的持續改進文化。

我們的創新策略涵蓋長期內的有機與無機雙軌計畫，重點在於透過推出以客戶為中心的連線照護與核心療法產品，加速銷售成長。連線照護產品包括可數位連線、溝通及/或分析數據的裝置或軟體，用以轉變醫療照護並改善病患結果，我們持續擴充連線照護產品組合，包括智慧牀系統、輸液泵、病患監測與診斷技術、呼吸健康裝置以及手術領域的先進設備。我們的核心療法產品組合包括用以解決病患與醫療人員在照護連續體中基本需求的藥物與消耗性醫療產品。
根據此策略，我們優先投資於產品領域，我們認為在這些領域有強勁的機會來更好地服務病患與醫療專業人員，特別是在成長率較高的市場。我們致力於加快將這些進步推向市場的速度，以支持我們未來的成長。
我們的策略也包含積極的資產組合管理，以最大化 Baxter 股東價值並最佳化 Baxter 的長期成功，與我們的獲利目標一致。我們定期評估資產組閤中各業務的戰略契合度以及我們營運的地理區域。資產組合的變動也可能來自通路擴張或市場開發活動。

如上文「近期戰略行動」所述，於 2023 年第三季，我們實施了一項新的作業模式，旨在簡化並優化作業流程，並更好地將製造與供應鏈與商業活動對齊。這些變動使我們走上成為更整合且靈活的組織之路，應能更有效地應對作業挑戰與總體經濟環境的變化，同時提升我們推動創新與持續優化產品組合的能力。於 2025 年 7 月，Andrew Hider 被任命為本公司總裁兼首席執行長，我們持續透過消除管理層級來簡化組織，以簡化組織、加速創新、拉近與客戶的距離並提升績效。

Baxter International Inc. 為一間全球醫療科技公司，約有 37,500 名員工，從事開發、製造與銷售廣泛的產品、數位健康解決方案及療法，供醫院、護理之家、復健中心、門診手術中心、醫生診所及在家接受醫師監督的患者使用。我們的全球據點與產品及服務的關鍵性，於 2025 年 12 月 31 日已於超過 100 個國家銷售，對拓展發達與新興國家的醫療衛生服務具有關鍵作用。

於 2024 年 8 月 12 日，本公司與 Carlyle Group Inc.（Carlyle）之部分關係企業簽訂 Equity Purchase Agreement（EPA），以出售本公司之腎臟照護業務。該業務現已更名為 Vantive Health LLC（Vantive），係由本公司先前之腎臟照護分部所組成。於 2025 年 1 月 31 日，本公司完成將腎臟照護業務出售給 Carlyle，總購買價格為 3.80 十億美元現金，扣除特定關閉現金、營運資金及債務調整後之金額。經考慮特定調整後，本公司於交易關閉時收到約 3.71 十億美元稅前現金，淨稅後現金約為 3.3 十億美元，扣除特定關閉後調整前之金額。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，本公司於 2025 年償還 3.81 十億美元之遺留債務（該償還不包含以新債券發行所得資金償還之 2.00 十億美元債務），主要係以出售腎臟照護業務所得之淨稅後現金進行償還。
本公司腎臟照護業務之財務狀況、營運成果及現金流，包括該業務出售所產生之獲利及相關現金所得，於隨附之合併財務報表中列為已終止營運，且本公司之前期財務資料已調整以反映已終止營運之情形。
本公司因出售腎臟照護業務，導致公司規模縮小，因此已產生並預期將產生額外之非協同效益，為確保本公司剩餘業務之成本結構適當，本公司已開始進行某些重整作業（並預計進行更多重整作業）。
請參閱本年度10-K表報第8項之附註2及附註5以取得更多資訊。
2023年第三季，本公司已完成新營運模式之實施，此模式旨在簡化及優化營運流程，並使製造與供應鏈更符合商業活動。根據此營運模式，本公司目前之業務由三個應報告分部組成：醫療產品與療法、醫療系統與科技、以及製藥（各項詳述如下）。
有關我們各應報告分部之財務資訊，請參閱本年度報告表 10-K 第 8 項附註 17。

2023 年 9 月 29 日，我們完成 BioPharma Solutions (BPS) 事業之出售，並從該交易中取得現金 $39.6 億。BPS 事業之營運成果與現金流，包括該事業出售所產生之 $28.8 億預稅獲利（淨稅後 $25.9 億）以及相關現金所得，於隨附之合併財務報表中列為已終止營運。我們將此交易之稅後所得 substantially 用以償還部分債務義務，包括 2023 年第四季償還之 $5.14 億商業紙債及 $22.8 億長期債務，以及 2024 年第二季償還之 €7.5 億優先債券。
有關更多資訊，請參閱本年度報告表 10-K 第 8 項附註 2 與 5。
我們全球之淨銷售額於 2025 年為 $112.4 億，較 2024 年報告基礎成長 6%，運營銷售基礎成長 3%。國際銷售額於 2025 年為 $51.2 億，較 2024 年報告基礎成長 7%，運營銷售基礎成長 5%。美國銷售額於 2025 年為 $61.2 億，較 2024 年報告基礎成長 5%，運營基礎成長 1%。有關淨銷售額運營銷售基礎之變動資訊，請參閱下方營運成果之淨銷售額討論部分。
2025 年歸屬於 Baxter 股東之淨損益為 $(957) 億，或每股稀釋後 $(1.87)。2025 年歸屬於 Baxter 股東之淨損益包含特殊項目，對淨損益造成 $20.9 億之負面影響，或每股稀釋後 $4.08。有關所有期間之特殊項目資訊，請參閱下方營運成果之特殊項目子節。
2025 年持續營運之淨損益為 $(900) 億，或每股稀釋後 $(1.75)。2025 年持續營運之淨損益包含特殊項目，對我們之結果造成 $20.7 億之負面影響，或每股稀釋後 $4.02。

與本公司營運相關的風險
與法律及法規事項相關的風險
與本公司普通股相關的風險
由於我們的戰略行動，我們面臨風險。
我們可能無法實現重大交易預期的效益，包括我們出售腎臟照護業務及收購Hillrom的交易。
我們的重大負債需要我們使用大量現金流用於償還債務，並限制我們追求成長策略及提升研發能力的能動性。
本公司可能無法成功推出或實現新舊產品或服務之商業價值，或無法跟上消費者偏好與需求之變化及科技之進步。
本公司可能無法達成財務目標。
本公司已經驗過供應鏈之中斷。
全球經濟情勢，包括通貨膨脹，已對本公司營運產生不利影響，並可能持續產生不利影響。
本公司營運成果與財務狀況已出現波動，未來可能持續出現波動。
外幣匯率與利率之變動已對本公司營運成果、財務狀況、現金流與流動性產生不利影響，未來可能持續產生不利影響。
未來若發生重大之商譽、無形資產及其他長期資產價值減損，將對本公司營運成果產生負面影響。
本公司各業務分部嚴重依賴與GPOs、IDNs及某些其他經銷商與買方之重大契約。
本公司可能無法以具備成本效益之價格或及時取得足夠之零組件或原材料。
本公司可能遭遇製造、滅菌、供應或配送之困難。
本公司已遭遇並可能持續遭遇品質管理或產品品質之問題。
本公司可能遭遇影響資訊科技系統或受保護資訊之違規與系統故障，包括因過時、網路安全違規及資料外洩所致。
本公司面臨將人工智慧、機器學習及其他新興科技整合至產品、服務及營運之相關風險。
本公司面臨在全球營運相關之風險。
paragraphs: 除本年度報告表10-K 其他資訊外，股東或潛在投資人應謹慎考量下列風險因素，以說明我們面臨的主要風險。若下列所描述之任何事件發生，將可能影響我們的業務、營運結果、財務狀況、現金流、未來成長前景、聲譽或股票價格。此外，其他未知或無法預測的因素，也可能對我們未來的營運結果產生重大不利影響。
以下風險摘要旨在提供我們所面臨風險的概覽，不應視為後續更詳細風險因素之替代。
•我們因戰略行動而面臨風險。
•我們可能無法實現重大交易預期的效益，包括出售腎臟照護業務及收購Hillrom。
•我們的重大負債需使用大量現金流用於償還債務，並限制我們追求成長策略及提升研發能力的空間。
•我們所從事產品市場競爭激烈，需求下降及價格壓力的風險可能對我們的業務、營運結果、財務狀況及現金流產生不利影響。
